newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were stronger on what traders said was modest volume, with new highs offset somewhat by position-squaring linked to the weak Swiss franc.
"We were higher but only on a limited basis. We underperformed today. There was a lot of position-squaring because of the weak franc," one Swiss-based trader said.
The March Confederate bond futures contract advanced to a new contract high of 120.94 on the day, overtaking the previous high of 120.89 set on Wednesday, but closed below highs.
Traders were looking ahead to next Thursday's Bundesbank central bank council meeting.
Some traders expected gains tied to speculation that the Bundesbank will ease rates next week. Such speculation would also likely be positive for Swiss bonds.
On Friday bond markets were bolstered by news that U.S. January producer prices fell 0.3 percent. The January core rate was unchanged.
March Conf futures CONFH7 up 21 at 120.65.
March Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 steady at 111.90
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 down three at 98.30.
